description: 2048, in 8BitScript, from one source tree, on the VIC-20, C64, PET, Commander X16, and the web.

scripts.build:web: 8bs build --target web --hardware machine=c64 && 8bs build --target web --hardware machine=pet-2001 && 8bs build --target web --hardware machine=vic20 && 8bs build --target web && cp site/index.html dist/web/index.html
scripts.check: 8bs check src/2048.8bs src/lib/draw/font.8bs src/lib/draw/palette.8bs src/lib/draw/tile.8bs src/lib/game/play.8bs src/lib/game/rules.8bs src/lib/host/host.8bs src/i18n/en.8bs src/i18n/de.8bs src/lib/layout/layout.8bs src/lib/raster/wobble.8bs src/lib/text/version.8bs src/ui/Board.8bx src/ui/Copyright.8bx src/ui/GameOver.8bx src/ui/HeaderArt.8bx src/ui/ScoreBar.8bx src/ui/Screen.8bx src/ui/Tile.8bx src/ui/TitleWobble.8bx src/ui/Version.8bx
